description: A common chronic inflammatory skin disease characterised by itch, dryness, and recurrent eczema.
causes: Skin-barrier dysfunction with genetic and environmental factors
risk_factors: Personal or family history of atopic disease

appearance.general: Dry, inflamed, itchy patches or plaques with variable scale, excoriation, or thickening.

warning_signs: Pain, pus, fever, rapidly spreading inflammation, or extensive blistering can indicate a complication requiring assessment.
general_first_aid: Avoid known irritants and excessive scratching.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss flare triggers, sleep disturbance, infection, and associated asthma or allergic disease.
